llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究传统工艺Ti-6Al-4V ELI的腐蚀疲劳行为，未涉及增材制造，与用户关注的增材制造Ti-6Al-4V力学性能方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not involve additive manufacturing; no indication of LPBF, SLM, EBM, or DED process; it likely studies wrought or conventionally processed Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究海水环境下双轴应力对Ti-6Al-4V ELI腐蚀疲劳行为的影响
summary_zh.method: 开展单轴与双轴应力下模拟海水腐蚀疲劳实验
summary_zh.result: 揭示了不同应力状态下的腐蚀疲劳寿命与失效机制
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验应力-寿命数据验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the corrosion fatigue behavior of Ti-6Al-4V ELI titanium alloy under biaxial stress states in simulated seawater for marine applications.
summary_en.method: Uniaxial and biaxial fatigue experiments were conducted in simulated seawater environment.
summary_en.result: The corrosion fatigue life and failure mechanisms were characterized under different stress states.
summary_en.validation: Experimental S-N data provide direct validation.
